feature: Pillar pages (#1485/#1621, screen 12) — the six real pillar landing pages in artifacts/portal, wired to the already-built GET /api/portal/pillars (pillar-summary-stats.ts). Real design landed in Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/screens/Pillar Pages.dc.html; pages live at artifacts/portal/src/pages/pillar.tsx, route /pillars/:pillar, reached from the shell's PillarTabStrip. Scope: pillar summary cards + scores only — the design's full per-check 'block' breakdown and the click-a-finding-for-full-breakdown + SOP/Runbook remediation offer are a real, separate follow-up (#1621's own open architecture questions).
notes: Git #4557 — NOT live-executed this session, for a real, confirmed-live reason: the serving checkout (C:\Source\ShaneMcCawConsulting\Shane-McCaw-MSP) could not fast-forward to this commit. `refresh-main-server.mjs`'s real ff-only merge failed with 'untracked working tree files would be overwritten' against `Bugs/Portal/2026-09-17-1236/...` (the exact QA session that filed #4557) — confirmed real error text, not a guess; filed as its own finding, #4559 (parented under #3707, labeled Shane To-Do since only Shane can clear the blocking directory). Root-cause A (the stale-fetch race) is instead verified by tracing the actual data flow end to end: usePillarPage.ts / usePillarSummary.ts's effects now list `scanPhase` as a dependency, sourced from PortalShell's real `useScanState()` (SSE + adaptive poll) via `scanStateContext.ts`, so a transition into `complete`/`partial` now genuinely re-triggers the fetch that used to fire once at mount. `tsc --noEmit` clean on artifacts/portal confirms the wiring type-checks end to end.

apiTests prove the real, already-built backend contract directly: log in via POST /api/auth/login, extract a bearer token, then exercise GET /api/portal/pillars exactly as usePillarPage.ts's own fetchWithAuth call does.

PILLAR_SUMMARY_KEYS order is fixed server-side (pillar-summary-stats.ts, asserted by its own cross-app order test) and reused here: governance=0, licensing=1, adoption=2, compliance=3, health=4, security=5, copilot=6 — asserted by index rather than a JSONPath filter (HttpTestExecutor.cs's TryResolveJsonPath has no `[?(@...)]` filter support, #3052).
No write assertions: /api/portal/pillars is a pure read (buildPillarSummary), so there is nothing to round-trip or restore.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_CUSTOMER_EMAIL / TEST_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD — the same Customer testbed account other portal manifests use.

UI steps deliberately assert the honest-state scaffolding (page shell, score hero, findings section) rather than exact score numbers or finding titles, which are real tenant data that changes with every scan run.

Git #4557 — sessionTag '4557-tenant-status-caption' steps assert the TenantStatusCard's cache-cleared outcome body (the exact real text Shane's QA session flagged: 'Showing its stored summary: ... The live log for it is gone.') no longer carries the internal-engineering phrase, and still carries the real check/pass/error counts. This is the deterministic, no-wait-required half of the fix — any fresh page load on a tenant with a prior completed scan but no live-witnessed run this session lands in 'cache-cleared' by construction (useScanState.ts), no scan trigger needed.

Git #4557's other real bug — usePillarPage/usePillarSummaryShell fetching /api/portal/pillars exactly once on mount, so a pillar page already open when a scan finishes never refreshed until reload — is a race against a real, multi-minute Microsoft Graph scan and is not asserted here as a bounded UI step; it was verified by tracing the actual data flow (usePillarPage.ts's effect now depends on the real useScanState phase via scanStateContext.ts, refetching on any phase transition, not by reproducing the multi-minute race end-to-end in this manifest). See build-journal/4557.md for the full trace.
